policyBrief.title: Urban stream ecosystem health as a One Health priority (OneAquaHealth Policy Brief)

quotes.text: The OneAquaHealth initiative investigated 100 urban stream sites across five European cities to assess how urbanization impacts freshwater ecosystems and how this degradation may increase health risks for people.
Pharmaceuticals were detected in 91% of monitored sites, confirming widespread contamination with risks for aquatic organisms and humans.
Diatom (microalgae) morphological deformities were identified as early warning indicators of pharmaceutical contamination that would go undetected by standard monitoring.
Urban freshwater ecosystem restoration should be prioritized as a preventive One Health measure that simultaneously protects biodiversity and reduces public health risks.

Degraded urban streams are associated with higher cause-specific mortality and reduced life expectancy, likely reflecting the loss of freshwater ecosystem services including water quality, climate regulation, and mental health benefits.

Invasive alien plants increase significantly with urbanization and pose direct human health risks through skin irritation, allergies, poisoning, and the creation of favorable habitats for disease vectors
Stream biofilms in more urbanized areas carry higher loads of clinically relevant pathogens and antibiotic resistance genes, posing human health risks.
Restoring degraded urban streams can help reduce health risks associated with poor water quality, flooding, heat waves, biodiversity loss, and limited access to blue-green spaces.

indicators.title: Water temperature
indicators.explanation: Water temperature is one of the basic readings OneAquaHealth takes at every site, alongside dissolved oxygen, pH and conductivity. Warm water holds less oxygen, and the project's Catalogue of Measures lists high water temperature among the altered physico-chemical conditions that stress urban streams. Shade from bankside trees helps keep water cool.

indicators.title: Riparian (bankside) vegetation
indicators.explanation: Riparian vegetation is the band of trees, shrubs and herbs along the stream banks. OneAquaHealth scores how much of each margin is covered by herbaceous plants, shrubs and trees. Intact bankside vegetation shades and cools the water, filters polluted runoff, holds banks together and gives wildlife a place to live.

indicators.title: Macrophytes (in-channel plants)
indicators.explanation: Macrophytes are plants growing in the stream itself: mosses, floating plants, submerged weeds, reeds and filamentous algae. The OneAquaHealth field form records which types are absent, present or extensive (covering more than a third of the channel) and whether non-native species are among them. Disappearing aquatic plants signal a loss of habitat.

indicators.title: Invasive alien plants and animals
indicators.explanation: Invasive alien species are plants or animals introduced outside their natural range that spread fast and cause harm. Along streams, invasive plants are counted along a 100-metre stretch of both banks. They thrive in disturbed, polluted places, so their presence signals degradation. Some cause skin irritation, allergies or poisoning, or shelter disease-carrying insects.

indicators.title: Water colour
indicators.explanation: Water colour is one of the observations the OneAquaHealth Citizen Science App asks people to record, together with flow type, vegetation, channel features and surrounding land use, backed by photos or video. The project sources do not define colour categories or thresholds, so colour is a prompt for follow-up rather than a measurement.

measures.name: Passive riparian vegetation: allowing natural regeneration
measures.oneLine: Let bankside plants grow back on their own by stopping mowing, grazing and vehicle access, where seed sources and soils are still intact.
measures.quote: Typical measures include the cessation of mowing, grazing exclusion, restriction of access by vehicles or heavy machinery, and the removal of pressures that prevent natural succession.

measures.name: Active riparian vegetation restoration: re-establishment riparian forest
measures.oneLine: Replant bankside vegetation with native, locally sourced species where it has been removed or invasive plants block natural regrowth.
measures.quote: accelerates the return of core riparian functions (bank stabilisation, shading, filtration, habitat structure).

measures.name: Constrained riparian vegetation corridors (“buffers”)
measures.oneLine: Where space is tight, protect at least a narrow vegetated strip along each bank to shade the water and catch pollutants from urban surfaces.
measures.quote: Provide shading, contributing to lower water temperatures and improved dissolved oxygen conditions;

measures.name: Vegetated corridors promoting connectedness
measures.oneLine: Link the stream to parks and green spaces in continuous green-blue corridors so people see, value and protect it, backed by clear ecological goals.
measures.quote: Reduce pressures associated with abandonment (e.g., dumping, informal occupation, excessive channel modification);

measures.name: In-stream self-purification enhancement
measures.oneLine: Add boulders, riffles, woody debris, varied substrate and aquatic plants so the stream oxygenates and cleans itself more effectively.
measures.quote: Increases oxygenation and aeration, improving conditions for aquatic life.

measures.name: Sewer system and point-source improvements
measures.oneLine: Fix leaking pipes, separate or buffer combined sewers and control industrial and domestic discharges so untreated sewage stops reaching the stream.
measures.quote: Reduces untreated discharges of sewage and pollutants during rainfall events.

measures.name: Litter, plastic, and hydrocarbon control
measures.oneLine: Trap litter, plastics and oil before they reach the water, clean banks regularly, and use signage, clean-ups and fines to stop dumping.
measures.quote: Reduces hydrocarbon contamination and oxygen depletion in water.

measures.name: Removing barriers
measures.oneLine: Remove obsolete weirs, dams and culverts so water, sediment and fish move freely again and stagnant pools disappear.
measures.quote: Improving water quality and longitudinal connectivity, enhances biodiversity and reduces the availability of breeding sites for mosquitoes and water-borne diseases.

measures.name: Stream bed re-naturalization
measures.oneLine: Take out concrete from the stream bed and replace it with local natural substrate and vegetation to restore varied flows and habitats.
measures.quote: Promotes natural colonization of native fauna and flora.

measures.name: Constructed riffles
measures.oneLine: Place sorted stones and boulders, often with transplanted aquatic plants, to create riffles that vary the flow and add habitat.
measures.quote: Constructed riffles involve the placement of stones and boulders that are size-sorted and placed with a gentle dip toward the channel centre, often reinforced with transplanted aquatic vegetation or macrophytes (Figure 11).

measures.name: Elimination of riverbank protection
measures.oneLine: Remove hard bank armouring such as concrete and let banks re-vegetate with native riparian plants and reconnect with the floodplain.
measures.quote: Improves water quality through filtration, shading, and organic matter retention.

measures.name: Floodplain reconnection and storage basins
measures.oneLine: Reconnect the stream with its floodplain or former side channels so floods spread out, groundwater recharges and riparian vegetation is supported.
measures.quote: Recharges groundwater and supports riparian vegetation.

measures.name: Citizen Science and educational partnerships
measures.oneLine: Involve residents, schools and universities in monitoring water quality and biodiversity, building local stewardship of the stream.
measures.quote: Enhances data availability and supports adaptive management.

measures.name: Regulatory and behavioural measures for pollution reduction
measures.oneLine: Combine regulation, enforcement and public campaigns so households and businesses stop pouring chemicals, oils, litter and medicines into drains.
measures.quote: Reduces illegal or accidental discharges, point-source inflows, and diffuse pollution.

measures.name: Control / Removal of invasive species
measures.oneLine: Remove invasive plants and animals, starting with small infestations, and keep monitoring because re-invasion is common.
measures.quote: Early detection and rapid response are therefore critical in determining both the level of effort required and the likelihood of success.

measures.name: Rain gardens
measures.oneLine: Build planted hollows that soak up and filter runoff from roofs and streets before it reaches drains; they must drain well to avoid standing water.
measures.quote: Removes nutrients, and hydrocarbons through filtration and biological uptake.

measures.name: Disconnection of impervious areas
measures.oneLine: Redirect runoff from roofs and paving into vegetated or permeable ground instead of storm drains, cutting overflows and pollutant loads.
measures.quote: Promotes infiltration and evaporation, mitigating flash floods and reducing pollutant loads.

measures.name: Natural wastewater treatment plants
measures.oneLine: Use constructed wetlands with plants and soil filters to treat wastewater before it can contaminate urban streams (an add-on, not stream restoration).
measures.quote: The plants provide surface area for microbial biofilms, facilitate oxygen transfer to the substrate, filter and adsorb pollutants, remove nutrients, and limit algal growth by reducing light penetration.

measures.name: Floating treatment wetlands
measures.oneLine: Float planted bioreactor islands in ponds or retention basins so plant roots and microbes break down pollutants in place (an optional add-on).
measures.quote: They are not part of the rehabilitation of the river and stream ecosystems but additional (optional) measures to be installed in wetlands or retention basins, that will contribute to prevent the contamination of urban freshwater ecosystems.

addressesNote: The 'addresses' mapping from citizen findings to measures is StreamRecord's editorial judgement based on each measure's stated objectives; the Catalogue does not itself map measures to foam, smell, colour or dead fish.

en.text: The OneAquaHealth initiative investigated 100 urban stream sites across five European cities to assess how urbanization impacts freshwater ecosystems and how this degradation may increase health risks for people.

pt.text: O projeto europeu OneAquaHealth investigou 100 ribeiras urbanas em cinco cidades europeias para avaliar como é que a urbanização impacta os ecossistemas de água doce, bem como é que esta degradação pode aumentar os riscos para a saúde humana.

it.text: L’iniziativa OneAquaHealth ha valutato 100 corsi d’acqua urbani in cinque città europee con lo scopo di quantificare gli effetti dell’urbanizzazione sugli ecosistemi di acqua dolce e comprendere in che modo il loro degrado potesse accrescere i rischi per la salute umana.

nl.text: In het kader van het OneAquaHealth-initiatief zijn 100 locaties langs stedelijke waterlopen in vijf Europese steden onderzocht om na te gaan welke impact verstedelijking heeft op zoetwaterecosystemen en in hoeverre deze achteruitgang de gezondheidsrisico’s voor mensen kan vergroten.

no.text: OneAquaHealth-initiativet undersøkte 100 urbane bekkesteder i fem europeiske byer for å vurdere hvordan urbanisering påvirker ferskvannsøkosystemer, og hvordan slik forringelse kan øke helserisikoen for mennesker.

fr.text: Dans le cadre de l'initiative « OneAquaHealth », 100 sites aquatiques urbains ont été étudiés dans cinq villes européennes afin de déterminer l'impact de l'urbanisation sur les écosystèmes d'eau douce et évaluer dans quelle mesure cette dégradation peut accroître les risques pour la santé humaine.

en.text: Urbanization consistently degrades freshwater ecosystem health and decreases biodiversity across European cities, with nutrient pollution, contamination by pharmaceuticals, alterations of the stream channel, soil sealing, artificial light at night, and loss of the natural riparian vegetation as the main drivers.

pt.text: A urbanização degrada de forma consistente a saúde dos ecossistemas de água doce e diminui a biodiversidade nas cidades europeias, sendo a contaminação por nutrientes e produtos farmacêuticos, as alterações dos leitos ribeirinhos, a impermeabilização dos solos, a poluição luminosa, e a perda de vegetação ripária natural as principais causas desta degradação.

it.text: L’urbanizzazione compromette progressivamente la salute degli ecosistemi di acqua dolce e riduce la biodiversità nelle città europee. Tra le principali cause figurano l’inquinamento da nutrienti, la contaminazione da residui farmaceutici, le alterazioni morfologiche dei corsi d’acqua, l’impermeabilizzazione del suolo, l’illuminazione artificiale notturna e la perdita della vegetazione ripariale naturale.

nl.text: Verstedelijking leidt in Europese steden tot een voortdurende verslechtering van de gezondheid van zoetwaterecosystemen en een afname van de biodiversiteit, waarbij nutriëntenverontreiniging, verontreiniging door geneesmiddelen, ingrepen in de waterloop, bodemafdekking, kunstlicht ’s nachts en het verdwijnen van de natuurlijke oevervegetatie de belangrijkste oorzaken zijn.

no.text: Urbanisering forringer gjennomgående helsetilstanden i ferskvannsøkosystemer og reduserer det biologiske mangfoldet i europeiske byer. De viktigste drivkreftene er næringsstoff- og legemiddelforurensning, fysiske inngrep i elveløp, nedbygging og asfaltering av jord, kunstig lys om natten og tap av naturlig kantvegetasjon langs vassdrag.

fr.text: L’urbanisation dégrade la santé des écosystèmes d’eau douce et réduit la biodiversité dans les villes européennes, avec comme principaux facteurs la pollution par les nutriments et les produits pharmaceutiques, la modification des cours d’eau, l’imperméabilisation des sols, la lumière artificielle nocturne et la perte de la végétation naturelle des berges.

en.text: Sixteen pharmaceuticals were observed in 91% of the sites, often as complex mixtures.

pt.text: Dezasseis produtos farmacêuticos foram detetados em 91% dos locais, frequentemente em misturas complexas.

it.text: Nell'ambito dello studio, sedici principi attivi farmaceutici sono stati rilevati nel 91% dei siti monitorati, spesso sotto forma di miscele complesse.

nl.text: Op 91 % van de locaties werden zestien geneesmiddelen aangetroffen, vaak als complexe mengsels.

no.text: Seksten ulike farmasøytiske stoffer ble påvist i 91% av bekkestedene, ofte som komplekse blandinger.

fr.text: Seize produits pharmaceutiques ont été observés sur 91 % des sites, souvent sous forme de mélanges complexes.

en.text: This contamination was mitigated in sites in good ecological condition.

pt.text: Esta contaminação foi reduzida em locais com boas condições ecológicas.

it.text: Al contrario, nei siti caratterizzati da un buono stato ecologico, i livelli di contaminazione sono risultati sensibilmente inferiori, evidenziando il ruolo delle condizioni ambientali favorevoli nel mitigare la presenza e gli effetti di tali contaminanti.

nl.text: Deze verontreiniging was minder ernstig op locaties met een goede ecologische toestand.

no.text: Denne forurensningen var mindre i lokaliteter med god økologisk tilstand.

fr.text: Cette contamination était atténuée sur les sites présentant un bon état écologique.

en.text: Diatom (microalgae) morphological deformities were identified as early warning indicators of pharmaceutical contamination that would go undetected by standard monitoring.

pt.text: Foram identificadas deformidades morfológicas em diatomáceas (microalgas) como indicador precoce da presença de produtos farmacêuticos, cuja presença não teria sido detetada através de métodos de monitorização tradicionais.

it.text: Le deformità morfologiche delle diatomee (microalghe) sono state identificate come indicatori precoci di contaminazione farmaceutica che, normalmente, sfuggono ai sistemi di monitoraggio standard.

nl.text: Morfologische afwijkingen bij diatomeeën (microalgen) werden aangemerkt als vroege waarschuwingssignalen voor verontreiniging door geneesmiddelen, die bij standaardmonitoring onopgemerkt zouden blijven.

no.text: Morfologiske deformiteter hos kiselalger (mikroalger) ble identifisert som tidlige varslingsindikatorer på farmasøytisk forurensning – endringer som ikke ville blitt avdekket gjennom standard monitorering.

fr.text: Les déformations des microalgues (diatomées) constituent des indicateurs d’alerte précoce de contamination pharmaceutique, non détectables par les méthodes standard de suivi.

en.text: Stream biofilms in more urbanized areas carry higher loads of clinically relevant pathogens and antibiotic resistance genes, posing human health risks.

pt.text: Os biofilmes de pedras submersas em áreas mais urbanizadas contêm uma maior abundância de agentes patogénicos clinicamente relevantes, e com mais genes de resistência a antibióticos, constituindo riscos para a saúde humana.

it.text: I biofilm presenti nei corsi d'acqua urbanizzati trasportano cariche elevate di agenti patogeni clinicamente rilevanti e geni di resistenza agli antibiotici, ponendo rischi per la salute umana.

nl.text: Biofilms in meer verstedelijkte gebieden bevatten grotere hoeveelheden klinisch relevante ziekteverwekkers en genen voor antibioticaresistentie, wat risico’s voor de volksgezondheid verhoogt.

no.text: Strømbiofilmer (biofilm i elver og bekker) i mer urbaniserte områder inneholder høyere nivåer av klinisk relevante patogener og gener for antibiotikaresistens, noe som utgjør en potensiell helserisiko for mennesker.

fr.text: Les biofilms des cours d’eau en zone très urbanisée contiennent des charges plus élevées de pathogènes cliniquement pertinents et de gènes de résistance aux antibiotiques, représentant un risque pour la santé publique.

en.text: Degraded urban streams are associated with higher cause-specific mortality and reduced life expectancy, likely reflecting the loss of freshwater ecosystem services including water quality, climate regulation, and mental health benefits.

pt.text: Ribeiras urbanas degradadas estão associadas com maior mortalidade por doenças por causa específica e esperança de vida mais reduzida, refletindo provavelmente a perda de serviços de ecossistema, incluindo a qualidade da água, regulação climática, e benefícios para a saúde mental.

it.text: Il degrado dei corsi d’acqua urbani è associato a un aumento della mortalità per cause specifiche e a una diminuzione dell’aspettativa di vita, verosimilmente in conseguenza della perdita dei servizi ecosistemici legati agli ambienti di acqua dolce, quali la depurazione delle acque, la mitigazione climatica e i benefici psicofisici per la popolazione.

nl.text: Aangetaste stedelijke waterlopen gaan gepaard met een hogere sterfte aan specifieke oorzakenen een lagere levensverwachting, wat waarschijnlijk het gevolg is van het verlies aan ecosysteemdiensten van zoetwater, waaronder waterkwaliteit, klimaatregulering en geestelijke gezondheidsvoordelen.

no.text: Degraderte urbane bekker er koblet til høyere årsaksspesifikk dødelighet og redusert forventet levealder, noe som trolig reflekterer tap av økosystemtjenester fra ferskvann, inkludert god vannkvalitet, klimaregulering og positive effekter på mental helse.

fr.text: Les cours d’eau urbains dégradés sont associés à une mortalité spécifique accrue et à une espérance de vie réduite, reflétant probablement la perte de services écosystémiques essentiels : qualité de l’eau, régulation climatique et bien-être mental.

en.text: The diversity of fish declined in more urbanized streams, while non-native species increased.

pt.text: A diversidade de peixes diminuiu em ribeiras mais urbanizadas, enquanto as espécies não-nativas aumentaram.

it.text: La diversità delle comunità ittiche è risultata inferiore nei corsi d'acqua maggiormente urbanizzati, mentre è aumentata la presenza di specie non autoctone.

nl.text: De visdiversiteit nam af in meer verstedelijkte beken, terwijl het aantal uitheemse soorten toenam.

no.text: Fiskemangfoldet gikk ned i mer urbaniserte bekker, mens forekomsten av fremmede arter økte.

fr.text: La diversité des poissons a diminué dans les cours d'eau les plus urbanisés, tandis que les espèces non indigènes ont augmenté.

en.text: Invasive alien plants increase significantly with urbanization and pose direct human health risks through skin irritation, allergies, poisoning, and the creation of favorable habitats for disease vectors

pt.text: Plantas exóticas invasoras aumentaram significativamente com a urbanização o que coloca riscos diretos para a saúde humana através de irritação cutânea, alergias, envenenamento, e a criação de habitats favoráveis a vetores de doenças.

it.text: Le piante aliene invasive aumentano significativamente con l'urbanizzazione e rappresentano un rischio diretto per la salute umana a causa di irritazioni cutanee, allergie, avvelenamenti e creazione di habitat favorevoli per i vettori di malattie.

nl.text: Het aantal invasieve uitheemse plantensoorten neemt aanzienlijk toe door de verstedelijking en vormt een direct gevaar voor de volksgezondheid door huidirritatie, allergieën, vergiftiging en het ontstaan van gunstige leefomgevingen voor ziekteverspreiders

no.text: Forekomsten av fremmede, invasive plantearter øker betydelig med graden av urbanisering og utgjør direkte helserisiko for mennesker gjennom hudirritasjon, allergi, forgiftning og ved å skape gunstige habitater for sykdomsvektorer.

fr.text: Les plantes exotiques envahissantes augmentent avec l’urbanisation et posent des risques pour la santé humaine : irritations cutanées, allergies, empoisonnements, ou création d’habitats favorables aux vecteurs de maladies.

en.text: intact riparian vegetation provide shade, regulating water and air temperature, filter pollutants from runoff, stabilize banks against erosion, and provide habitat for both aquatic and terrestrial biodiversity

pt.text: vegetação ripária intacta proporciona sombra, regula a água e a temperatura, filtra contaminantes trazidos pela escorrência de águas, estabiliza as margens e previne a erosão, e proporciona habitat para a biodiversidade aquática e terrestre

it.text: Quest’ultima svolge funzioni essenziali per il funzionamento degli ecosistemi fluviali, contribuendo alla regolazione termica, alla filtrazione degli inquinanti, alla stabilizzazione delle sponde e al mantenimento della biodiversità.

nl.text: Intacte oevervegetatie biedt echter schaduw, reguleert de water- en luchttemperatuur, filtert verontreinigende stoffen uit afstromend water, stabiliseert oevers tegen erosie en biedt een habitat voor zowel aquatische als terrestrische biodiversiteit

no.text: Intakt kantvegetasjon gir imidlertid skygge som regulerer vann- og lufttemperatur, filtrerer forurensning fra avrenning, stabiliserer breddene mot erosjon og gir leveområder for både akvatisk og terrestrisk biologisk mangfold.

fr.text: une végétation des berges intacte fournit de l'ombre, régule la température de l'eau et de l'air, filtre les polluants présents dans les eaux de ruissellement, stabilise les berges contre l'érosion et offre un habitat à la biodiversité aquatique et terrestre

en.text: Therefore, the restoration of urban freshwater ecosystems should be acknowledged as a form of preventive public health intervention.

pt.text: Por isso, o restauro de ecossistemas de água doce, deve ser reconhecido como uma medida de intervenção para a saúde pública.

it.text: Per queste ragioni, il ripristino degli ecosistemi acquatici urbani dovrebbe essere riconosciuto e promosso come una misura pubblica di prevenzione sanitaria a tutti gli effetti.

nl.text: Daarom moet het herstel van stedelijke zoetwaterecosystemen worden erkend als een vorm van preventieve volksgezondheidsmaatregel.

no.text: Restaurering av urbane ferskvannsøkosystemer bør derfor anerkjennes som et forebyggende folkehelsetiltak.

fr.text: C'est pourquoi la renaturalisation des écosystèmes d'eau douce urbains devrait être reconnue comme une mesure préventive en matière de santé publique.

en.text: Investing in ecosystem restoration has the potential to significantly reduce healthcare expenditure over time.

pt.text: Investir no restauro dos ecossistemas tem potencial para reduzir significativamente os custos com a saúde.

it.text: Gli investimenti in interventi di restauro ecologico non solo migliorano la resilienza ambientale delle città, ma possono contribuire nel lungo periodo a ridurre l'incidenza di patologie correlate al degrado ambientale e, di conseguenza, i costi sostenuti dai sistemi sanitari.

nl.text: Investeren in het herstel van ecosystemen kan op termijn de uitgaven voor de gezondheidszorg aanzienlijk verminderen.

no.text: Investeringer i økosystemrestaurering har potensial til å redusere helseutgifter betydelig over tid.

fr.text: Les investissements dans la renaturalisation des écosystèmes ont le potentiel de réduire considérablement les dépenses de santé à long terme.
